line: Moving to the north suburbs, cops ran a nigga to the hills
vault_lines: Moving to the north suburbs, cops ran a nigga to the hills
meaning:
From late 2012 to June 2014, Chief Keef lived in 2 mansions in the north suburbs area of Chicago. The first was in Northbrook and the second being in Highland Park.

First he moved from his Northbrook home in November 2013 after falling behind on rent which led to the owner of the home suing Keef for the unpaid rent, but eventually it was settled outside of court.

After leaving his Northbrook home Keef decided to move to Highland Park just before he checked into rehab, while living in the home Keef was getting into trouble with the police for things such as DUI & shooting at his manager’s home.

On June 10, 2014 Keef was eventually evicted from the home for falling behind on rent again once again. Keef began falling behind on rent in February and according to an agreement, had until April 20 to pay the owed amount. Keef responded to being evcited in segment with TMZ by saying “I’m too bad, I guess I’m a bad little young boy, I gotta go.”

Sometime in July 2014 after being evicted from the Highland Park home, Keef decided to relocate to Woodland Hills, Los Angeles to stay out of trouble and also due to being harassed by police. In an interview with media outlet The Outline His former manager Dro had this to say

In Highland Park. Tell me how safe, how much you’d want to stay around something like that. A tire popped and you walk outside the house, fifteen to twenty police officers with AK-47s with their fingers on the trigger. At any given time they could have made a mistake, or said, you know, ‘I see a gun!’ and AK-47s — ain’t no turning back from that.
